text:
maria (eng-ml): Quick sync — finished the GPTQ + AWQ interop sweep across Llama2, Mistral, and Qwen. Posting a compact readout and a few ops notes. TL;DR: GPTQ gives best latency/cost on our infra; AWQ occasionally preserves instruction-following on Mistral variants; Qwen at 4-bit shows the biggest accuracy drift and needs special fallback.

sam (eng-ml): Awesome, can you drop the short metrics snapshot here?

maria (eng-ml): Sure. High-level deltas vs fp16 baseline (avg over helm/instruction evals):
- Llama2-70b gptq-4: +0.8% instr-accuracy delta, latency -28%, tokens/sec +3.
- Mistral-7b awq-4: -0.4% instr-accuracy delta (better on preference tasks), latency -22%.
- Qwen-7b gptq-4: -3.7% instr-accuracy delta, several regressions on long-context QA.

lee (eng-ml): That Qwen number looks bad. Was that consistent across seeds/evals?

maria (eng-ml): Qwen regressions concentrated on: long-context retrieval QA and some math prompts. Re-run with 3 random seeds: two runs show similar deltas (~-3.2 to -4.1). We flagged ~12 prompt templates with >5% drop.

olivia (research): Did you compare AWQ vs GPTQ for Qwen? Any AWQ wins?

maria (eng-ml): AWQ for Qwen wasn't stable — AWQ-4 produced better primary perplexity in a few cases but produced hallucination spikes on open-domain prompts. Overall not worth defaulting to AWQ for Qwen until we isolate the failure modes.

sam (eng-ml): Can you paste the exact eval command and quant config you used?

maria (eng-ml): Command we used for the sweep:
```
python infra/evals/run_eval.py \
  --model-name {MODEL} \
  --quant-method {gptq|awq} \
  --bits 4 \
  --eval-sets helm,instruction,math,qa-long \
  --seed {0,1,2} \
  --batch 8
```
Quant metadata snippet: `gptq: perchannel, block_size=128; awq: outlier_clip=0.02, group=128`

lee (eng-ml): Any infra/oom issues to call out?

maria (eng-ml): Notes: AWQ on Mistral-15B OOM'd on a2a when kv_cache enabled for seq_len=2048 — workaround was `--disable-kv-reorder` and lowering batch to 4. GPTQ runs occasionally hit a kernel timeout on older drivers for Llama2-70b; updating to cuda 12.2 driver fixed it.

juan (eng-sre): I'll schedule a short upgrade window for the driver on a2a test pool. For production pools, we should have rollback pins. What are the recommended deployment profiles?

maria (eng-ml): Recommended defaults based on sweep:
- Hosted (low-latency SLO): use GPTQ-4 for Llama2 variants, with prefix-KV cache enabled.
- Dedicated (predictable throughput): Mistral -> AWQ-4 for 7B/15B only after canary with instruction evals.
- Qwen -> default to INT8/GPTQ-8 or fp16 for 4-bit-risky variants; require canary + eval gate.
Fallback chains: gptq-4 -> gptq-8 -> int8 -> fp16. Auto-fallback on >2% instr-acc drop or latency >SLO.

olivia (research): For the canary, can we auto-run the diff eval on every rollout? I'd like to gate on a set of 300 instruction prompts + 200 long-ctx QA samples.

maria (eng-ml): Yep, we wired that into the rollout harness. Canary runs in ~45m for 7B profiles with our batch settings; for 70B it takes ~3.2h.

sam (eng-ml): Any surprising edgecases found?

maria (eng-ml): A few:
- Tokenization mismatch: Qwen quant runtimes had a preprocessing mismatch for some multi-byte tokens — fixed by normalizing NFKC in the tokenization step.
- Prompt-sensitivity: some instruction templates flip order-of-operations style answers when quantized; these were reproducible.
- Latency tail: Llama2 GPTQ shows heavier 95th percentile on bursty short requests if batcher isn't capped — recommend max-batch-ms 15.

dev-bot: CI: quant-sweep job #847 passed (18/20 checks). Failing checks: qwen-4bit-regression-tests, mistral-awq-oom-case.

lee (eng-ml): Can we add watchdogs on CI to auto-tag failing model variants so we don't promote them?

maria (eng-ml): Good idea — action item: add auto-tag + block in the release pipeline for any model variant that fails the instr-accuracy gate (>2% drop) or OOM.

juan (eng-sre): I'll add autoscaler limits and driver upgrade for a2a pool this week.

olivia (research): I'll run a prioritized deep-dive on the 12 Qwen prompt failures and send a short doc with counterexamples.

sam (eng-ml): Thanks — if possible, include a few minimal repro prompts and the model outputs pre/post quant.

maria (eng-ml): Will do. Uploading artifacts + per-prompt diffs to: https://redwood.internal/quant-sweeps/1845001234 (contains logs, cfgs, per-prompt diffs).

lee (eng-ml): ack. Let's sync tomorrow at 10 for rollout decisions. :calendar:
